method: Each module 02–06 and 08–09 closes with decision log + sequence + desk walk (same as 01/07). 10 and 11 are sequence-only (jurisdiction matrix · live platform teardown). Pitch last.

modules.done_when: Sequence + postings table another PM can implement
Decision log + sequence for one spec fork (errors / idempotency / who owns the contract). OpenAPI may follow the sequence; it does not replace it.
Lecture + #/exam-recon + practice. Decision log + sequence in 03_decision_log.md / 03_sequence.md.
Lecture + #/exam-rg + practice + desk walk. Terms in 04_terms.md. Log + sequence. Captured after self-ex does not credit the wallet.

Lecture + #/exam-psp + practice + 05_decision_log.md / 05_sequence.md. No retry 3DS fail as capture. Cascade = new deposit_id after soft only. Mocks multi-PSP on desk may follow; not required to close.

Lecture + #/exam-bonus + practice + 06_decision_log.md / 06_sequence.md. Cash vs bonus ring-fenced. Wagering = turnover. Early cash withdraw forfeits open bonus. Abuse hold on payout, not payout_sent. Desk mocks optional after close.
Decision log + sequence for another PM (options/kill/metric live in those two files)
Lecture + #/exam-kyc + practice + 08_decision_log.md / 08_sequence.md. Three gates; vendor webhook ≠ PAM until PAM writes; reject does not void open round. Desk walk optional — skipped on close.

09_terms + lecture + L2 drill in chat + 09_decision_log.md / 09_sequence.md. Dispute ≠ withdraw. One dispute key per deposit. Hold before lost. Won vs lost. Shortfall ($50 CB / $30 pocket) = separate policy row later. Exam/desk optional.
10_decision_log.md / 10_sequence.md only (no desk). UK vs MGA vs US-style matrix: KYC when, RG, bonus ring-fence.
11_decision_log.md / 11_sequence.md. Template filled for 2 operators + 1 PAM vendor (user may fill live later). Money path only.
